newsitem.title: USA: Man beats wife after she pulls plug on cybersex.
newsitem.headline: Man beats wife after she pulls plug on cybersex.

text.p: An Arkansas man became so enraged after his wife stopped his cybersex affair with a Canadian woman that he beat her on two occasions, police said on Thursday.
Marion Walton's wife, Pat, 54, learned of his Internet infidelity and stopped it by erasing from his computer the programme he used to send and receive sexually explicit messages.
In retaliation, she told police, Walton, 40, threw her against the wall and bruised her neck and arms.

Lloyd Hartzell, the police chief in the small city of Russellville, said the incident occurred last week. Three days later Mrs. Walton called police to say her husband had again attacked her, the chief said.
She was advised to seek an arrest warrant but has not yet done so.
The Canadian woman was not identified.
